data.description:
## Description

**What**: Author plugins/dso/docs/onboarding-resume-contract.md as the authoritative contract for /dso:onboarding's resume behavior. Two sections: (1) freshness predicates per phase; (2) phase-invocation log schema.

**Why**: Both the RED tests (S1) and the orchestrator implementation (S2) assert on or write the phase-invocation log artifact. Without a frozen schema before S1, the RED tests are either brittle (over-specifying incidental format) or under-specifying (passing on malformed logs). Defining the contract first is the architectural answer.

**Scope**:
- IN: Markdown table (rows = init, dialogue, architect-foundation, generate-claude-md; columns = output_artifact, freshness_predicate, dependent_inputs, re-run_trigger). Log schema section: file path = ${WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR}/onboarding-phases.log; format = one JSON object per line (JSONL); fields = phase_name (enum), invocation_reason (enum: freshness_passed_noop | freshness_failed_executed | dependent_artifact_changed), outcome (enum: noop | executed | errored); append-per-phase semantics; ordering = chronological per run.
- OUT: Implementation of the predicates or the log writer (S2). Test fixtures (S1).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, plugins/dso/docs/onboarding-resume-contract.md exists with the freshness-predicate table and the phase-invocation log schema section as specified
  ← Satisfies: "A freshness-check contract is documented at plugins/dso/docs/onboarding-resume-contract.md containing a markdown table whose rows are the four phases and whose columns are output_artifact, freshness_predicate, dependent_inputs, re-run_trigger."

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] The contract is the integration point for the orchestrator (S2), the RED test (S1), and the SUB-AGENT-GUARD test (S6). Drift between the contract and any consumer is a regression risk — documentation must precede code.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a contributor, the resume contract for /dso:onboarding (freshness predicates per phase + phase-invocation log schema) is documented before any implementation begins
